title: Reassign can pick a technician outside the filter and the card then leaves
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both). Your own staff record must also be an eligible technician (Settings > Staff > your record > Clockable on, role not Office or Time Clock User, enrolled here), e.g. "Aaron Keating".
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 2 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Ralph Edwards", "Dana Ortiz"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Dana Ortiz") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. Create the work order: Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the case customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its asset > create it, and write down its number (e.g. "S1-702").
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to "Aaron Keating".
    • On the Lines tab click New Line, enter a name (e.g. "Brake inspection") and labor hours (e.g. 2.0), and save the line.
    • Click the line's Approve (check) button so the work order status reads Approved.
    • Make sure you are not this work order's service advisor and no line is assigned to anyone but you.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab, pick Board View and turn on Assigned to me.
  2. Write down which technician columns are shown.
  3. Hover the card, click More actions and choose Reassign lead technician.
  4. Read the technicians offered.
  5. Pick Ralph Edwards and confirm (keep shifts if asked).
  6. Read the board and its header count.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The dialog offers Ralph Edwards and Dana Ortiz although their columns are not on screen under Assigned to me.
  • After the change the work order no longer matches Assigned to me and disappears from the board without a reload (your column count goes from 1 to 0).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-E4, S4-E8, read 8 Oct 2026. Assigned to me behaviour S1-R13 / S3-N1. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-E4: “The Reassign dialog allows destinations outside the current filter.”
  • S4-E8: “After reassignment, remove the work order from results if it no longer matches the filter.”
